collection.title: Audi S5 Sportback 2010 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Audi S5 Sportback 2010 - 2017 which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
